snippet.title: AIMCADEMY - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Aimcademy is a science-based aim trainer which combines gaming with sport science! This leads to the most efficient way of training by embracing variation and personalization instead of repetition and cookie-cutter tasks.

Wishlist Aimcademy now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646660/Aimcademy/
